titles.display: Kol language (Papua New Guinea)

description: Language isolate of Papua New Guinea
extract: The Kol language is a language spoken in eastern New Britain island, Papua New Guinea. There are about 4000 speakers in Pomio District of East New Britain Province, mostly on the southern side of New Britain island.
